I have noticed that my bluetooth headphones don't work when I open the fridge door. There was a video on YouTube explaining that fridges have harmful radiations, but I thought they were exaggerating. Now I am scared as shit. If it's enough to open the door to create interference with bluetooth, imagine how much radiations the fridge produces.
It's true that fridges produce radiations!!!

Electromagnetic radiation is NOT the same as ionizing radiation. Any appliance or device with a motor, large coil, magnetron tube (microwave generator) or even just a switch mode power supply (nearly all modern electronic devices) will produce electromagnetic radiation. Is it harmful? Well that depends on the frequency of the oscillation and the power output. The Sun puts out shitloads of electromagnetic radiation, including visible and invisible light, as well as microwaves, xrays and radio waves. Most of the harmful energy is absorbed by our atmosphere but some still gets through to cause damage. As for your fridge, well it's not putting out enough electromagnetic energy to cause you harm. Your bluetooth headphones are probably being interfered with by another phenomenon called multipath interference since the electromagnetic field of a fridge is no where near the frequency of bluetooth (BT ~2.4 GHz, fridge ~60 Hz). The bluetooth signal is probably bouncing off the metal surfaces of your fridge and hitting the receiver/antenna with the same signal but at different times. This causes cancellation of the waves which destroys the data on the signal. The dropout is due to the headphones not being able to get a clean signal rather than the 60 Hz fridge output causing interference. Unless your fridge has Wifi or BT on it, the likelihood of direct interference is very low. Also, depending on whether your fridge is in the signal path of the BT signal, the metal doors which may or may not be grounded can disrupt the BT signal by attenuation and multipath interference.

At the end of the day, the EMF output of your fridge is not at all harmful and your BT issue is caused by some other reason than your fridge's EMF output. A lot of the YouTube EMF stuff is bullshit and you should not just accept it as real without some research and knowledge to help you discern fact from fear. Your more likely to be harmed by solar radiation than EMF from your appliances.
